formula.expression: FFPI = (w_s*S + w_l*L + w_h*H + w_v*V) / (w_s + w_l + w_h + w_v)
formula.note: One of several published weightings (NOAA/NWS Smith 2003; Romanian mountain basins). Uncalibrated for Ukraine: calibrate and verify on historical flash-flood events before use for decisions.

s.source: slope_deg from the 30 m DEM (WhiteboxTools slope)

l.source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, overview factor 4 (~37 m)
l.note: runoff disposition of the land use: built-up and bare highest, forest and wetland lowest

h.source: hydrologic soil group from the soil map of Ukraine (data_dnipro_h_q src/soils.py, src/hsg_grid.py)
h.note: infiltration capacity; a gap in the soil map gets the default and is counted (hsg_gap_px)

v.source: ESA WorldCover classes as a vegetation-density proxy (no NDVI source yet)

sources.dem: FABDEM v1-2 (30 m, forests and buildings removed)
sources.soils: Soil map of Ukraine, HSG derived from texture (gleyed, peat, solonetz -> D)
sources.population: WorldPop 2020 UN-adjusted constrained 100 m v2.0, CC BY 4.0 (hromada exposure only)
sources.admin: COD-AB Ukraine v05 valid 2025-09-01 (OCHA / SSPE Kartographia), ADM3 = hromada
